community_list_entries.section: Resources / Benchmarks and Tasks / Long-Term Memory Evaluation
community_list_entries.name: LOCCO
Evaluating the Long-term memory of large language models

phase1_classification.kind_reason: The LOCCO dataset (Long-Order Chronological Conversations, Findings of ACL 2025, no arXiv version found) evaluates LLM long-term memory of chronological dialogues. Memory is imparted by sequential supervised (LoRA) fine-tuning on each time period, and retention and forgetting are then measured.

phase1_verified_types.parametric: §2.2: "We adjust model parameters through supervised fine-tuning, enabling models to internalize key information from long-term dialogues". §4.3: models are trained sequentially over six periods and tested on D1 using Q1 after each phase.
